Rules for this run: never wait on a background task; run `npm run check` (or the targeted test files) in the foreground; commit and push to a branch early and often; if you must wait for something, park with submit_report resumeWhen, never by ending the turn.

Build (Bank code pre-approved by Mitchell in that 1:1; keep it additive, no data rewrite):
(b) Debit as the session runs, not only at its end: book usage incrementally (per turn or per N tokens, e.g. every turn's usage delta or every ~20k adj. tokens) through the same charge path (runtime session.ts chargeUsage → core budget.ts charge/recordUsage/drawFromInput), so Budget.fundingFor's next pick sees the real remaining balance of the key/input. The session-end charge becomes the remainder (total − already booked), never a double debit; the usage log keeps one row per session or clearly marks partial rows so finance-spend sums are unchanged. Host sessions and desk sessions both.
(c) No lost usage on failure: a session that fails, crashes, is killed (spend-limit death, cap, container death) or ends without submit_report still has every token it used counted and debited. Find every exit path in runtime (host runAgentSession, desk runDeskSession, the fallback-report path) and make the final charge run in a finally/ensure step from the last known usage counters (the desk should report usage progressively, e.g. in heartbeats, so the host has the counters even if the desk dies). Tests: a test per exit path that the debit equals the usage; a test that incremental + final never exceeds total usage; existing check:finance identities stay green (npm run check:finance against the live API if reachable).

Docs: add the rule to docs/invariants/bank.md (next free invariant number) and a line to the Bank topic pages you touch (rewrite dc_1l4r6tw7vl and dc_32xbgegtvn for what changed). Then PR + self-merge with green CI (or push straight to main with green tests), note the commit; CI redeploys. Do NOT do (a) (the Donate-form ceiling line): it is as_wwz0uvipwd, already queued separately.

decisions.text: A vision doc docs/how-work-gets-done.md: one narrative of how work gets done in a Muster Town (owners and the Planner; declarative exploration; grants carry their key results; free tokens, earmarks, no pools; exploration uncapped by default; the map from the tree), with a build order, docs-only PR merged by the fork. Queued as as_5pkqisma36.

Map obvious fixes now, as code: no empty lot per unassigned goal, no plaza per building, pack the buildings so it feels like a town; the overall shape (tree / radial / plazas) is recommended by the vision doc instead. Queued as as_8ahfilyw6j.

Build step 1 (after the doc): Bank pools deleted (obsolete since mt_529jbnwvmi decision 1; prod is all General), earmarks stay; the per-goal exploration allowance goes, exploration is capped only by desks and free tokens with an optional cap per goal or town-wide; one "free tokens" number with a reservations table. Mitchell's go in this 1:1 is the Bank sign-off. Queued as as_1nuoiauxlw, waits on as_5pkqisma36.

Build step 2: key results merge into grants. A grant is filed against a goal and carries its own dated, checkable key results (today's testing plan folds in); goals keep no key results; set_key_result / propose_key_result, the yellow stoplight and "KR with no funded grant" go; open KRs with no grant are archived as explorer seeds. Reverses 1:1 mt_593ps69z8y (10-25). Queued as as_1sf0r2pdi4, waits on as_1nuoiauxlw.

Build step 3: declarative exploration. A rule on the goal (on/off, chunk default 100k, optional cap), inherited down the tree; the runtime tick, not the manager, reserves a chunk whenever a building has a free desk and free tokens, starts one explorer session that investigates one direction and ends with a grant proposal (with key results) in the review deck. Queued as as_blzwbep587, waits on as_1sf0r2pdi4.
